intermediate_blending_limitation: At fixed mature age, compatible pair controls visually reach their combined endpoint by approximately 50% of each signed axis; 50/75/100% look very similar. Single influences still change across the range. A linear/bilinear mod interior is an explicit first pass approximation, not the exact viewer morph logic or timing.
